name: Empath
ability: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbors are evil.

storytellerNotes: Poisoning creates an alternative world for an Empath result; a result does not identify which neighbour is evil.

explanation: A sustained claim must stay consistent as living neighbours change. A false count can divide trust between neighbours.
